title: featurePlanImpact
responsibility: Discover affected pages of a source-bound feature proposal and register its read-only CLI command.

inputs.name: featurePlanImpact.input
inputs.description: JSON object with a committed sourceCommit and plan changes; other proposal fields are ignored.

examples.expected: matching committed metadata and discovered pages returned
valid false with affected pages and diagnostics

inputs.name: featurePlanImpact.dependencies
inputs.type: optional trusted metadata reader and coverage validator
inputs.description: Defaults to the real committed metadata admission and coverage discovery for the current project.

inputs.name: registerFeaturePlanImpact
inputs.description: Registers task plan impact with a file input and optional JSON output.

outputs.name: featurePlanImpact
outputs.description: Validates proposal fields, reads metadata for that exact revision, and delegates page impact and blockers to the coverage validator without source scanning or mutation.

outputs.name: registerFeaturePlanImpact
outputs.description: Prints the discovered pages and every blocker; invalid impact sets a nonzero process exit code.

errors.name: invalid proposal or unavailable metadata
errors.description: Rejects before producing a result or starting a provider.

errors.name: incomplete impact
errors.description: Returns and prints coverage blockers instead of claiming page discovery is complete.
